title: Mapping Stability Compass
text: Treasure Crystal Balls in the Topological Labyrinth have a 20% chance to contain a Mapping Stability Compass.

Hold the compass when entering a Void Portal to reach the immediately adjacent room through its opposite exit instead of a random room. The compass is not consumed and does not protect against hazards.

Sneak-use to bind your currently configured respawn point. Hold use for 3 seconds to return across dimensions, spending all remaining mana. Releasing use cancels without a cost. An unbound or invalid point returns you to world spawn. Return travel passes through stability fields from Spatial Stability Anchors and upgraded Wandering Star Cluster Orbs.
